title: Site-Specific Investigation of DNA Holliday Junction Dynamics and Structure with 6-Methylisoxanthopterin, a Fluorescent Guanine Analog
one_liner_zh: 该文用荧光鸟嘌呤类似物结合分子动力学模拟研究DNA Holliday Junction的结构与动态，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作识别线索，但核心是DNA结构本身，非TF-DNA结合体系，且方法以荧光实验为主、模拟为辅，与课题匹配度有限。
abstract: DNA Holliday Junction (HJ) formation and resolution is requisite for maintaining genomic stability in processes such as replication fork reversal and double-strand break repair. If HJs are not resolved, chromosome disjunction and aneuploidy result, hallmarks of tumor cells. To understand the structural features that lead to processing of these four-stranded joint molecule structures, we seek to identify structural and dynamic features unique to the central junction core. We incorporate the fluorescent guanine analog 6-methylisoxanthopterin (6-MI) at ten different locations throughout a model HJ structure to obtain site-specific information regarding the structure and dynamics of bases relative to those in a comparable sequence context in duplex DNA. These comparisons were accomplished through measuring fluorescence lifetime, relative brightness, fluorescence anisotropy, and thermodynamic stability, along with fluorescence quenching assays. These time-resolved and steady-state fluorescence measurements demonstrate that the structural distortions imposed by strand crossing result in increased solvent exposure, less stacking of bases and greater extrahelical nature of bases within the junction core. The 6-MI base analogs in the junction reflect these structural changes through an increase in intensity relative to those in the duplex. Molecular dynamics simulations performed using a model HJ indicate the primary sources of deformation are in the shift and twist parameters of the bases at the central junction step. These results suggest that junction-binding proteins may use the unique structure and dynamics of the bases at the core for recognition.
abstract_zh: DNA霍利迪连接体（Holliday Junction, HJ）的形成和解析是维持基因组稳定性的必要条件，涉及复制叉逆转和双链断裂修复等过程。如果HJ未被解析，则会导致染色体分离异常和非整倍性，这些是肿瘤细胞的标志特征。为了理解导致这些四链连接分子结构被加工的结构特征，我们旨在识别中央连接核心特有的结构和动态特征。我们在模型HJ结构的十个不同位置掺入荧光鸟嘌呤类似物6-甲基异黄嘌呤（6-MI），以获取相对于双链DNA中可比序列背景下碱基结构和动态的位点特异性信息。这些比较通过测量荧光寿命、相对亮度、荧光各向异性和热力学稳定性，以及荧光猝灭实验来完成。这些时间分辨和稳态荧光测量表明，链交叉引起的结构扭曲导致溶剂暴露增加、碱基堆积减少以及连接核心内碱基的额外螺旋性质增强。连接中的6-MI碱基类似物通过相对于双链中强度的增加反映了这些结构变化。使用模型HJ进行的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟表明，变形的主要来源是中央连接步骤处碱基的位移和扭转参数。这些结果表明，连接结合蛋白可能利用核心处碱基的独特结构和动态进行识别。
